text:
Sanaa (infra PM): Quick heads-up — we're opening two new Dedicated capacity SKUs next week: H100-80GB NVL for high-throughput workloads and A10G-mid for lower-cost inference. Regions coming online: eu-west-3 (Paris) and ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Reservations open today for committed pools: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/reserve :rocket:

Javier (capacity eng): Nice. Do we have rough perf/latency numbers vs existing A100 pools?

Sanaa (infra PM): Short answer: H100 ~2x throughput vs A100 for Llama2-13B at 2048 context in our internal harness. Latency similar on equivalent batch sizes. We'll publish the full perf matrix on the console by EOD.

Mei (sales): Can existing Dedicated customers swap capacity into these SKUs or is it new add-on only? Customers asking about migration path.

Sanaa (infra PM): It's opt-in. No forced migrations. Customers can request add-on pools or renew with H100-backed capacity. Support will help with any migration steps.

Priya (support): I'll draft a KB + customer email template. Link to draft when ready.

Luca (sre): Any maintenance window to bring these nodes up? Need to plan oncall.

Sanaa (infra PM): Minimal control-plane churn. We'll do a canary in us-west-2 this Friday 2024-04-26 02:00 UTC (short restarts for a subset of agents), then broad rollout Mon-Tue 2024-04-29/30. Expected downtimes: two ~5m rolling restarts (control plane agents), app plane unaffected. deploy-bot will post exact timing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: Canary us-west-2 -> Broad rollouts 2024-04-29 to 2024-04-30. Release ref: go/release/1234.

Rajesh (platform): Heads-up for quota owners: new quota buckets and SKU codes will appear in the portal. If teams need increases for demos or GA customers, please request via quotas channel or the portal.

Javier (capacity eng): SDK/CLI change needed: add eu-west-3 & ap-south-1 region identifiers and new sku codes (h100-nvl,a10g-mid). I'll send a PR today.

Mei (sales): Pricing? Customers expect delta vs A100.

Sanaa (infra PM): Committed rates will be posted on the pricing page later today. Ballpark: H100 committed ~15% discount vs on-demand H100 list; A10G-mid positioned for cost-sensitive inference. Exact numbers in the email + pricing doc.

Priya (support): Draft KB: https://docs.internal/dedicated/h100-mumbai-paris (WIP). I'll add FAQ about SLA, migration, and billing.

Mei (sales): Any SLA changes for Dedicated with H100?

Sanaa (infra PM): No SLA change — Dedicated SLA still applies. We'll publish an addendum note mentioning hardware types supported.

Luca (sre): Action items for infra team: (1) update region registry (Javier), (2) prepare canary runbook and rollbacks (Luca), (3) update observability dashboards for new SKUs (ops), (4) post incident channel watch during rollout.

Sanaa (infra PM): Action items (short): 1) SDK & console region/sku update (Javier), 2) Support KB & customer comms (Priya), 3) Sales one-pager + pricing FAQ (Mei), 4) Canary run + rollout ops (Luca/deploy-bot). Please ack here if you own an item.

Luca (sre): ack

Javier (capacity eng): ack — PR incoming.

Priya (support): ack — KB coming in ~2h.

Mei (sales): ack :party:

Sanaa (infra PM): Thanks all — I'll post the perf matrix and pricing links into this thread when available. If you want early access for a customer pilot, DM me and we'll carve capacity out of the reserved pool.
